title: CSM review suite config namespace
description: Bounded, non-authority presentation settings for the csm-review namespace of csm-skills-config/1. Only verbosity is configurable; severity/evidence vocabulary, sandbox containment, report immutability, write discipline, lifecycle, credentials, and write scope are never granted here. Unknown keys are rejected.

verbosity.description: Presentation verbosity of review reporting; never changes severity/evidence authority.
